purpose: Make the ChatGPT supervisory layer over autonomous ClayCode cycles explicit without pretending GitHub Actions can invoke ChatGPT-only tools.

web_official_primary_sources.use: verify current compiler/runtime/provider/API/tool claims and discover current primary technical sources
web_official_primary_sources.rule: technical claims prefer official docs/research papers; current provider capability must be rechecked when material

github_connector.use: read current Clay state, inspect commits/actions/receipts, compare branches, write steering/control/research artifacts
github_connector.rule: respect concurrent writes; no force overwrite; current repository evidence outranks stale chat context

google_drive_connector.use: retrieve project-source documents or historical research corpus when the current question depends on Drive material
google_drive_connector.rule: do not search Drive on every cycle when current repository evidence already closes the question

file_library_search.use: retrieve prior uploaded files/images/PDFs when they contain relevant ClayCode/Frank evidence not already canonicalized
file_library_search.rule: use only when materially relevant; connector/file evidence must be cited or routed into durable research artifacts

python_or_local_reasoning_runtime.use: bounded analysis, differential calculations, parsing or experiment design when available in the active ChatGPT session
python_or_local_reasoning_runtime.rule: do not claim future automation can execute a session-local Python/container tool unless that run actually exposes it

connected_google_services.use: only if a ClayCode research dependency genuinely lives on that connected surface; never call merely to increase tool count

other_installed_connectors.use: the supervisor may inspect/use installed connected tools when they materially improve evidence or execution; absence of relevance is not a failure to use them

automations.use: hourly condition-watch supervisor that reviews autonomous cycles and steers only on meaningful evidence

repo_autonomous_capabilities: NVIDIA hosted FREE development APIs through canonical NIM adapter
Mistral FREE Mode adapter when MISTRAL_API_KEY is reachable
NVIDIA code embeddings and current free reranking endpoint
OpenAlex/arXiv/Crossref/DDGS and other zero-cost verified discovery surfaces
Judge0 and other verified zero-cost bounded execution surfaces
existing ClayGraph/UnifiedDB/research corpus and source-chain evidence
hard_boundary: ChatGPT-only tools are supervision capabilities, not callable functions of the GitHub Actions process. The two layers communicate through durable GitHub cycle receipts, supervisor inbox/state and steering control.
tool_use_law: Use every materially relevant available capability, not every tool indiscriminately. Evidence quality and information gain determine tool use.
